boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Randolph-Macon College
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and convenience stops in and around Ashland with evening or overnight availability.

cards.title: Birdsong Cafe
cards.subtitle: Randolph-Macon campus
cards.notes: Check the dining page before heading over; Birdsong Cafe lists weekday service through 10 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: Campus cafe with the latest named weekday dining hours listed by RMC Dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Randolph-Macon Dining lists Birdsong Cafe open Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current dining page lists Monday–Friday hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; weekend hours are listed as 11 a.m.–9 p.m.

cards.title: Estes Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Randolph-Macon campus
cards.notes: Use the dining schedule to plan an evening meal; Estes lists weekday dinner service until 8:30 p.m., subject to academic-calendar changes.
cards.short_summary: The college dining hall’s published weekday dinner window extends into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Randolph-Macon Dining lists Estes Dining Hall dinner Monday through Friday from 4:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current dining page lists weekday dinner from 4:30–8:30 p.m.; weekend dinner is listed 5–8 p.m.

cards.title: Cook Out
cards.subtitle: 800 England Street, Ashland
cards.notes: Confirm the day’s service before leaving campus; the Ashland location is listed late every night, with later Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru and pickup stop with documented overnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ashland Cook Out listing shows hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps lists 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 804 England Street, Ashland
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering page to verify availability before a late pickup; it identifies this Ashland location as serving late-night food.
cards.short_summary: An official location page explicitly identifies Ashland service as extending to late night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page says its Ashland location at 804 England Street serves menu items “to late night.”
cards.access_notes: Official location page describes late-night service but says hours vary; confirm with the restaurant before travel.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 401 England Street, Ashland
cards.notes: Order through the store page for delivery or carryout, then recheck the live closing time shown at the top before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ashland pizza location with an official page showing midnight closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 401 England Street, Ashland states the location is open until 12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official store page showed “Open Today Until 12:00 AM” when fetched; location hours can change.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 9539 Kings Charter Drive, Ashland
cards.notes: For the latest run, use the official location page and select carryout or delivery; it posts midnight closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-midnight pizza option in Ashland with published location-specific hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists the Ashland location at 9539 Kings Charter Drive open until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 9539 Kings Charter Drive, Ashland
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 10 a.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday; other days close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Wawa
cards.subtitle: 100 N Washington Highway, Ashland
cards.notes: Stop in for made-to-order food or convenience items at any hour; confirm individual food-counter availability in store if timing matters.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Ashland convenience stop with food and drink options documented by Downtown Ashland.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Ashland’s profile identifies the Wawa at 100 N Washington Highway as open 24 hours a day, every day, with food options.
cards.access_notes: Downtown Ashland reports the store is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

cards.title: TA Ashland
cards.subtitle: 100 North Carter Road, Ashland
cards.notes: Use the travel store for a snack or drink after other kitchens close; the operator describes 24/7 fuel and food, snack, and drink options.
cards.short_summary: A highway travel center whose official page documents round-the-clock service and food-stock options.
cards.evidence_claim: TravelCenters of America says TA Ashland is ready to fuel trips 24/7 and offers food, snack, and drink options at its travel store or restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Official page states 24/7 availability for fuel and describes food, snack, and drink options; Fuddruckers is separately listed 10 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Sheetz
cards.subtitle: 12341 Washington Highway, Ashland
cards.notes: Use the location’s ordering link or call ahead if you need made-to-order food; its current map listing shows the store open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience destination on Washington Highway north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The current map listing for Sheetz at 12341 Washington Highway shows it open 24 hours on every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: Waze’s current location listing shows 00:00–00:00 Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 11263 Washington Highway, Ashland
cards.notes: Use this named convenience-store stop for packaged snacks, drinks, or hot-food items; check the store directly for live overnight service details.
cards.short_summary: An official 7-Eleven location page identifies this Ashland store and its food and hot-food offerings.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official location page identifies the store at 11263 Washington Highway in Ashland and lists food and hot-food categories.
cards.access_notes: The official page confirms the location and food offerings but does not publish hours; call (804) 624-0423 to verify late availability.
